purposes.seed: Repeatable small surface colour variation, without gameplay randomness.
purposes.surface_variation: Small facet value changes make fur, chitin and worn armour readable without noisy patches.
purposes.radial_sides: Low-poly contour detail shared by limb and body sections.
purposes.body_rings: Profile detail for organic body volumes.
purposes.roughness: Dry fur, cloth and tarnished armour rather than shiny toy surfaces.
purposes.family_colour_fraction: Mix the existing family colour into neutral body materials; stronger accents retain threat recognition.
purposes.armour_base_rgb: Dark weathered iron/stone plate colour, retaining readable family accents without pale toy armour.
purposes.armour_edge_rgb: Quieter worn rims and raised plate edges distinguish metal/stone from cloth.
purposes.idle_cycle_seconds: Length of the isolated breathing/hover preview, not an AI timer.
purposes.walk_cycle_seconds: Time for one in-place review stride. Runtime pacing must use actual travel, as CreatureMotion already does.
purposes.animation_fps: Sampling resolution preserves current 0.25/0.22-second windup/recovery values accurately in glTF clips.

proportion_notes.beasts: Retain the existing low four-legged profile, forward muzzle and six-part bone layout; hounds are lean, whelps stockier, elk carry antlers and hooves.
proportion_notes.crawlers: Six splayed segmented legs and overlapping chitin ridges use the existing eight-part skeleton; the larger bog lurker remains green.
proportion_notes.humanoids: Hooded archer with bow, stone-faced shield guard, flared-throat shrieker and armoured knight. Body/head/paired arm-leg pivots follow CharacterLook's current convention.
proportion_notes.wisps: Small suspended pale or ember core surrounded by broken dark shells, retaining existing family scales and colours.
proportion_notes.tyrant: Large forged cuirass, shield arm, clawed gauntlet and paired crown horns retain the current boss cues and scale.
proportion_notes.collision: Original upright CapsuleShape3D dimensions come from enemy.tscn and boss.tscn, never from the art bounds. Model/elite size does not resize these existing bodies; report their visible mismatch without changing combat.
proportion_notes.motion: Rigid part weights match the prototype's six/eight-part approach. Idle, walk, windup and release are presentation clips; passive elk has no attack clips. Boss inhale uses the existing breath telegraph time. No root travel, hit events, damage, ragdolls or new AI.
